## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mdsr)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(hms)
library(dplyr)
```


When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Combine all the weekly Earnings

#All the states
state_initials <- c("AL", "AK", "AZ", "AR", "CA", "CO", "CT", "DE", "FL", "GA",
                    "HI", "ID", "IL", "IN", "IA", "KS", "KY", "LA", "ME", "MD",
                    "MA", "MI", "MN", "MS", "MO", "MT", "NE", "NV", "NH", "NJ",
                    "NM", "NY", "NC", "ND", "OH", "OK", "OR", "PA", "RI", "SC",
                    "SD", "TN", "TX", "UT", "VT", "VA", "WA", "WV", "WI", "WY")

weekly_earnings_all <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(state_initials)){
  name <- state_initials[i]
  new_data <- read_csv(paste0("raw_data/weekly_earnings/", name, ".csv"), skip = 1) |>
    rename(Date = 1, weekly_earnings = 2) |>
    mutate(State = name)
  weekly_earnings_all <- bind_rows(weekly_earnings_all, new_data)}
#Save
write_csv(weekly_earnings_all, "weekly_earnings_all.csv")

```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
#Weekly Hours
state_initials <- c("AL", "AK", "AZ", "AR", "CA", "CO", "CT", "DE", "FL", "GA",
                    "HI", "ID", "IL", "IN", "IA", "KS", "KY", "LA", "ME", "MD",
                    "MA", "MI", "MN", "MS", "MO", "MT", "NE", "NV", "NH", "NJ",
                    "NM", "NY", "NC", "ND", "OH", "OK", "OR", "PA", "RI", "SC",
                    "SD", "TN", "TX", "UT", "VT", "VA", "WA", "WV", "WI", "WY")

weekly_hours_all <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(state_initials)){
  name <- state_initials[i]
  new_data <- read_csv(paste0("raw_data/weekly_hours/", name, ".csv"), skip = 1) |>
    # Renames the columns
    rename(Date = 1, weekly_hours = 2) |>
    mutate(State = name)
  weekly_hours_all <- bind_rows(weekly_hours_all, new_data)}

write_csv(weekly_earnings_all, "weekly_earnings_all.csv")
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
